messages:
jessica: FYI customer acct_04512 reports Console shows 'Trial credit: $150' badge but API usage / invoices show charges and metering returns 0 for credits applied. They say this started after promo code redemption yesterday.

samir: can you paste repro steps and any request ids? is this hosted or dedicated?

jessica: hosted. Steps: they create API key through Console, run a gen request against /v1/generate with the key, get 200 + text tokens. Console shows badge in Billing > Credits. Invoice shows normal token charges. customer screenshot: https://files.redwood.internal/links/ss-acct04512.png

jessica: curl example they ran:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-04512" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":50}'
```

jessica: response body fine, request id header: x-request-id: rq_Yz12ab34

billing-bot: metering service log lookup for acct_04512 between 2024-12-01 and 2024-12-10: found token usage entries: total_tokens=8423, credits_applied=0, promo_id=NULL.

matt: tagging in billing /cc @matt. Quick thought: promo may have been applied to org-level billing but usage attributed to a sub-account or namespace, so credit delta shows in Console org view but not linked to the API keys' metering rows. Can you confirm org_id vs billing_account_id for this customer?

support-ops: do they use consolidated billing / multiple projects? any linked subaccounts?

jessica: customer says single account, but they have two API keys created under two different projects in the Console. Not sure if projects map to subaccounts.

matt: ok please run this internal query and paste results (truncate PII):
```sql
SELECT project_id, org_id, billing_account_id, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM billing.metering
WHERE account_id = 'acct_04512'
GROUP BY project_id, org_id, billing_account_id;
```

jessica: pasted results:
```
project_id: proj-alpha | org_id: org-900 | billing_account_id: bill-900 | tokens: 5421
project_id: proj-beta  | org_id: org-900 | billing_account_id: bill-901 | tokens: 3002
```

matt: aha — proj-beta usage is tied to a different billing_account_id (bill-901) while the promo credit was applied to bill-900. That explains Console org-level badge (applied to bill-900) but metering for proj-beta shows charges.

samir: is this a data model bug (projects mapping to billing accounts) or a UI attribution issue?

matt: looks like two things: promo assignment flow should block assignment when multiple billing accounts exist; and metering attribution should include a fallback to org-level credits during invoice generation. I'll open a billing-ops ticket and assign to eng-billing.

jessica: created ticket BILL-1287 with details + customer contact. Customer asked for interim credit while fix in progress. Can we grant manual credit to bill-901?

matt: we can issue a one-time adjustment. I'll action once billing ops approves. @support-ops can you add the manual adjustment request to the ticket and mark P0 for customer impact?

support-ops: yes added. Also leaving note to update our promo application docs so sales know to check multi-billing setups.

jessica: told customer we found cause, ticket opened, manual credit pending.

samir: nice find. can you add repro steps for engineering in the ticket (how to reproduce in staging)? especially the case: org has two billing_account_ids and promo applied to one project only.

matt: will do. Also scheduling a short postmortem next week to decide if we auto-apply promos across all linked billing accounts or prevent promo until owner clarifies.

jessica: thanks all — I'll follow up with the customer once manual credit is applied. :thumbsup:
